11R&D Project : Smart Power Box
Project Site Location : Don Muang Tollway
Project Cost : 0.6  Mill. THB
Start : Apr. 2025
Finish : Jul. 2025
Status : Done 
Benefit : The cost-reduction project aims to reduce 
electricity consumption from the electric utility by 
switching to solar energy. It also stores surplus electricity 
in decommissioned EV car batteries that are still in good 
condition. In addition to providing electricity for nighttime 
use, this approach recycles used batteries to maximize 
their value, helps conserve natural resources, and offers a 
method for reducing battery waste, which is considered 
hazardous.
